questions.statement: In this season it is very cold, and in some countries it snows. What season is it?
questions.context: Los niños de Bogotá ven en televisión países del norte donde en una estación cae nieve.

options.feedback: Correct. Winter is the coldest season, and in some countries it snows.
Incorrect. Summer is the hottest season, so it does not snow.
Incorrect. In spring the weather gets warmer and flowers grow.
Incorrect. In autumn the leaves fall; it gets cool, but the coldest season is winter.

questions.explanation: En los países con cuatro estaciones, el invierno ("winter") es la estación más fría y a veces nieva ("it snows"). El verano ("summer") es caliente y en la primavera ("spring") crecen las flores.
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: In this season the leaves turn red, orange and brown and fall from the trees. In the United States people call it "fall". What is its other name?
questions.context: En la clase de inglés en Medellín, la profesora muestra una foto de árboles con hojas rojas y cafés.

options.feedback: Incorrect. Winter comes after the leaves fall, and it is the cold season with snow.
Incorrect. In spring new green leaves and flowers grow; leaves do not fall.
Correct. Autumn is the season when the leaves fall; in the United States it is called "fall".
Incorrect. In summer the trees are green and it is hot.

questions.explanation: El otoño se dice "autumn" (inglés británico) o "fall" (inglés de Estados Unidos). "Fall" también significa caer, porque en esa estación las hojas caen de los árboles.
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: Complete the sentence: "In summer it is ___. We go to the beach and swim."
questions.context: La familia de Juliana vive en España y en verano viaja a la playa de Valencia.

options.feedback: Incorrect. Snow falls in winter, not in summer.
Incorrect. Cold weather is typical of winter; summer is hot.
Correct. Summer is the hot season, so it is a good time to swim at the beach.
Incorrect. Icy means covered with ice, and ice belongs to winter, not to summer.

questions.explanation: En verano ("summer") hace calor: "it is hot". Por eso la gente va a la playa a nadar. Las palabras "snowy", "cold" e "icy" describen el invierno.
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: Flowers grow and birds sing. The weather gets warm after the cold winter. What season is it?
questions.context: En un libro de inglés del colegio en Pereira hay un dibujo de un jardín con flores nuevas y pájaros.

options.feedback: Incorrect. Autumn comes before winter, and in autumn leaves fall.
Incorrect. Winter is the cold season; the text says the cold winter is over.
Incorrect. Summer comes after spring; the season right after winter is spring.
Correct. Spring comes after winter: it gets warm and flowers grow.

questions.explanation: La primavera ("spring") llega después del invierno: el clima se pone tibio ("warm"), crecen las flores y cantan los pájaros. El orden es "spring, summer, autumn, winter".
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: Read: "Colombia does not have four seasons. We have a rainy season and a dry season. In the rainy season it rains a lot." What do children take to school in the rainy season?
questions.context: Colombia está cerca de la línea del Ecuador y por eso no tiene cuatro estaciones.

options.feedback: Incorrect. A sled is for snow, and the text talks about rain in Colombia, not snow.
Incorrect. A swimsuit is for the pool or the beach, not for walking to school in the rain.
Incorrect. The text describes rain, not ice, so gloves for ice are not needed.
Correct. In the rainy season it rains a lot, so an umbrella keeps children dry.

questions.explanation: Colombia está en la zona ecuatorial y no tiene las cuatro estaciones. Tiene temporada de lluvias ("rainy season") y temporada seca ("dry season"). Si llueve mucho, se necesita una sombrilla ("umbrella").
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: Emma lives in Canada. It is winter and it is snowing. Which clothes does she need?
questions.context: Emma, una niña colombiana, se fue a vivir a Canadá y allá llegó el invierno.

options.feedback: Incorrect. Shorts and sandals are summer clothes; Emma's legs and feet will be cold.

options.text: a coat, a scarf and gloves
options.feedback: Correct. A coat, a scarf and gloves keep the body warm in the cold winter.
Incorrect. A swimsuit is for swimming in hot weather, not for snow.
Incorrect. A T-shirt and flip-flops are for hot days; they do not protect from snow.

questions.explanation: En el invierno de Canadá hace mucho frío y nieva. Se necesita ropa caliente: abrigo ("coat"), bufanda ("scarf") y guantes ("gloves"). Pantalones cortos o chanclas son ropa de verano.
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: Read: "Lucas visits his cousin in Spain in July. It is hot and sunny. They swim in the sea every day." What season is it in Spain?
questions.context: Lucas viaja desde Cali para visitar a su primo en España durante las vacaciones de mitad de año.

options.feedback: Incorrect. Winter in Spain is cold, and the text says it is hot and sunny.
Correct. July in Spain is hot and sunny, and people swim in the sea: it is summer.
Incorrect. In autumn it gets cooler and leaves fall; the text describes very hot days.
Incorrect. Spring in Spain is warm with flowers, but July with hot sea days is summer.

questions.explanation: España tiene cuatro estaciones. En julio es verano ("summer"): hace calor ("hot"), hay sol ("sunny") y la gente nada en el mar. Las pistas del texto confirman que no es invierno ni otoño.
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement:
Read the dialogue.
Carla: "What is your favorite season?"
Diego: "___"
questions.context: Carla y Diego conversan en el recreo de un colegio de Manizales sobre la estación que más les gusta.

options.text: I like winter because I can play in the snow.
options.feedback: Correct. It names a season and gives a true reason: there is snow in winter.

options.text: I like summer because it is very cold.
options.feedback: Incorrect. Summer is hot, so "very cold" is a wrong reason.

options.text: I like spring because the leaves fall.
options.feedback: Incorrect. Leaves fall in autumn; in spring new leaves and flowers grow.
Incorrect. "Yes, I do" answers a yes/no question, but Carla asks "What...?" and wants a season.

questions.explanation: La pregunta "What is your favorite season?" pide el nombre de una estación. La mejor respuesta nombra una estación y da una razón verdadera: en invierno hay nieve. Las otras tienen datos falsos o no responden a "What".
questions.subject: ingles
